results.title: Legendary Entertainment and Sony Pictures Ending Distribution Deal - Hollywood Reporter
results.content: Subscribe for full access to The Hollywood Reporter Subscribe for full access to The Hollywood Reporter Legendary Entertainment and Sony Pictures Motion Picture Group are parting ways, The Hollywood Reporter has confirmed. In late 2022, the two companies announced that Sony would become Legendary’s go-to studio in terms of releasing and marketing its movies around the globe (excluding China). The news that Sony and Legendary are terminating their deal isn’t a surprise to Hollywood insiders. The Legendary films handled by Sony included the biblical comedy The Book of Clarence, which stumbled upon its release last year. results.title: Sir Alex Ferguson’s company ACF Sports Promotion earns £2.7 million profit - Yahoo
results.content: # Sir Alex Ferguson’s company ACF Sports Promotion earns £2.7 million profit Sir Alex Ferguson’s company ACF Sports Promotion earns £2.7 million profit Manchester United’s legendary manager Sir Alex Ferguson’s success keeps growing as his company, ACF Sports Promotion, turned a profit last year of £2.7 million. Ferguson spent 27 glorious years at Old Trafford where he won everything and turned the club into England’s most successful team. They state, “there appears to be no stopping Sir Alex Ferguson’s financial success, with the personal company set up by the 83-year-old when he was manager of Aberdeen recording a £2.7 million profit last year.” The company, ACF Sports Promotion, now has assets of £26.9 million, up from £24.2 million the previous year.

results.title: EXCLUSIVE: Bonpoint and Porsche Have Made the Perfect Outfits for Baby Drivers - WWD
results.content: # EXCLUSIVE: Bonpoint and Porsche Have Made the Perfect Outfits for Baby Drivers. The capsule collection of clothes and accessories is inspired by the German sports car manufacturer's legendary 911 model. In what may be the most unexpected brand collaboration since Issey Miyake’s iPhone Pocket for Apple, French luxury childrenswear brand Bonpoint is launching a capsule collection based on the German sports car manufacturer’s 911 model. Popular with celebrities ranging from Tom Cruise to LeBron James and Mary-Kate Olsen, the legendary car has inspired a limited-edition line of ready-to-wear and accessories for children and babies dubbed My First Porsche, which will be available from March 11 in Bonpoint boutiques worldwide and online. Together, Bonpoint’s savoir-faire and Porsche’s legendary design transform childhood joy into lasting memories,” she said. In addition to its in-house Porsche Design label, which produces everything from hoodies to eyewear, the company has collaborated with fashion brands including Puma, Boss and Aime Leon Dore.
